Fees left as recorded ($44/$50 posted on the operator's rates page) - but Campspot actually charges $46.51 + mandatory fees, see flags. Note trimmed of the price/booking text.
flags: Price gate (no gateway within 40 km - nearest Orlando 91 km; the family has not stayed here): one night on Campspot for 2026-11-10 is $46.51 site + $2.50 'Resort Fee' + $1.40 'Processing Fee' = $50.41 before tax (and Campspot's $3 booking fee) - just over US$50 once the mandatory fees are counted. The operator's own rates page posts $44/day (30-amp) and $50/day (50-amp) with no fees mentioned; fees left as recorded (manual) for a human to decide.

Long-stay: a 55+ 'RV and manufactured home community' (age-qualified); monthly $509, weekly $180-190. Nightly rates are posted and one night sells on Campspot, so tests 2-3 pass; test 5 (homes vs RV sites) could not be judged - no home count or homes-for-sale page found.
